hero.title: Building Cyber‑Grade Digital Experiences
hero.subtitle: I design and build high‑performance web and mobile apps with a focus on modern UI/UX, clean architecture, and automated deployment.

aboutSection.p1: I’m a senior Android and full‑stack developer based in Bexley, England. I specialize in Kotlin, Next.js, and modern frontend stacks, with a strong focus on performance, design quality, and CI/CD automation.
aboutSection.p2: My work spans from advanced Android apps with Jetpack to production‑ready Next.js portfolios and Kotlin Ktor backends with comprehensive integration testing.
aboutSection.p3: I enjoy blending English and Burmese in technical content, experimenting with neon/glassmorphic UIs, and shipping polished, automated deployments.

neonTask.title: Neon Task
neonTask.shortDescription: A cyberpunk-styled task manager with real-time sync and offline support.
neonTask.description: Neon Task is a PWA task manager built with Next.js 15, Tailwind, and a Kotlin Ktor backend. It features optimistic UI updates, end-to-end encryption, and a fully offline-capable experience.
neonTask.overview: Describe the problem, your approach, architecture decisions, and key outcomes. Include diagrams, code snippets, and performance metrics as needed.
